title: “Don’t Get Me Wrong, I’m Not Without Ego!”: How Nick Mohammed Earned His Rep as the Nicest Man in British Film and TV
summary: The magician-turned-'Ted Lasso' star talks Sky's addictively sexy legal thriller 'War' and leveling up to U.K. household-name status in a certain BBC reality show: "Increasingly, I think 'Celebrity Traitors' is an analogy for one's career in this industry. It's so unpredictable."
